description: This file defines the TerminationSignalWatcher class, which manages handling termination signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT) to facilitate graceful shutdown of the application. It sets up signal handlers, logs received signals, stops pairing prompts, and terminates the app cleanly.

classes.name: TerminationSignalWatcher
classes.description: A singleton class that monitors system signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT) and handles graceful termination procedures when such signals are received.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes signal handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT if they are not already installed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Removes signal handlers and resets the termination requested state.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up a signal handler source for the specified signal, ignoring the default signal action, and assigning a custom handler.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Executes when a termination signal is received; logs the signal, stops pairing prompts, terminates the app, and schedules an emergency exit if needed.
